description: This Java class defines services related to supplier products within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving suppliers for a product with filtering and sorting options, and for converting product features for a specific supplier.

classes.name: SupplierProductServices
classes.description: Provides services for handling supplier and product feature related operations within OFBiz.

methods.name: getSuppliersForProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of supplier products related to a specific product, filtered by optional parameters such as partyId, currencyUomId, quantity, agreementId, and whether drop shipping is allowed. Results are sorted by price ascending.

methods.name: convertFeaturesForSupplier
methods.description: Converts product features based on supplier-specific information, replacing their description and idCode with data from SupplierProductFeature entities for a given partyId.
